the reason is \\u0027below year facet\\u0027 when the vehicle\\u0027s year is under the scenario\\u0027s minimum for its model (Filters.MinYearFor), \\u0027over mileage\\u0027 when its mileage exceeds Filters.MaxMileage, \\u0027search moved\\u0027 when this run\\u0027s zip or radius differs from those of the run that last saw the posting, and \\u0027not on search page\\u0027 otherwise, checked in that order; proven by LedgerDiffService tests for each reason using an in-memory ledger, including the 2010 Insight and the zip-move cases from the report\u0022,\u0022RunEntity records the scenario zip and radius the run searched with (nullable columns added by an EF migration under src/Odonomics/Ledger/Migrations, applied by the existing migration path); a prior run with no recorded zip or radius never yields \\u0027search moved\\u0027; proven by a test\u0022,\u0022The Gone table still fits its 80-column NarrowTable without wrapping a VIN, and search and walk both show the reason; the README\\u0027s diff description names the four reasons; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-40 at the end of walk run 4 (2026-09-24 22:10 to about 01:10 EDT on 2026-09-25, zip 32833, cap 30; notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md, Gaps found; full output notes/walk-2026-09-24.txt). Gone (28) no longer overlaps New, so the baseline bug is fixed, but Gone now mixes cars that left the market with cars the walk simply no longer visits: three are below the year facet (JHMZE2H79AS041642, a 2010 Insight) and the Daytona-area cars (4T1DAACK9TU267793 at Daytona Toyota) fell outside the radius when the zip moved from Daytona to 32833. Code: the Gone list is built at the end of LedgerDiffService.DiffAsync in src/Odonomics/Ledger/LedgerDiffService.cs (GonePostingEntry record at the top of the file); rendering is RenderGone in src/Odonomics/Cli/DiffRenderer.cs; RunEntity is in src/Odonomics/Ledger/Entities.cs (Command, StartedAt, CompletedAt, Sources) and carries no facet snapshot today, which is why \\u0027search moved\\u0027 needs the run to record zip and radius; the facets come from Scenario (Zip, RadiusMiles, Filters.MinYearFor(makeModel), Filters.MaxMileage; see ListingQuery.For in src/Odonomics/Sources/ListingQuery.cs). Do not geocode or compute distances; \\u0027search moved\\u0027 is a comparison of recorded facets between the two runs.
